flags.message: Salience-version mismatch on every candidate (gemini-baseline, claude-baseline, codex-baseline): each prediction froze band 'baseline' under salience_version 'sal-v3', while the committed metrics/statpack.md renders the 'Segment base rate by salience band' table under 'sal-v4'. Per the evaluate prompt the table is no baseline for that band, so segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score are omitted and base_rate_basis is null on all three evaluation.json files. Note for the stamp: statpack.json still carries a sal-v3 alt_segments block (OT2017-OT2025; baseline-band reached figures pool to ~5.0% over n~12,720), so the harness's version-pinned pooling may resolve a claim baseline even though the rendered table cannot. The evaluator-written trio is left null as the prompt's only sanctioned answer.

codex-baseline's retrieval.md discloses three CourtListener MCP searches that failed with HTTP 429, but its captured retrieval_log.json (29 calls, coverage 1.0) carries no mcp call class; the only non-shell rows are two 'other' entries whose text the harness redacted as credential-shaped. The disclosed calls are therefore unobserved in the log. Not a leakage concern (forward cell, searches named companion cases only); noted because the staged log and the candidate's own disclosure cannot be reconciled from the blinded view.
